description: Browse books by format without free-text query. Every item carries `warnings` (show them to the user together with the book), `age_rating`/`age_gate` (`age_gate`=true means 18+ material), and `ad_label`/`advertiser` (the product link is advertising).

format.description: Book format; `book` and `ebook` are synonyms of `text`.

limit.description: Maximum number of books to return (1-50, default 10).

offset.description: Number of books to skip, for paging (default 0).

name: books_by_format
